loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: How much likelier a Lore-Collector's rolls against a foe it has sized up are to succeed, through its next turn, after spending its turn on an Intelligence check (when it worked; never without it). 1.25× is a nudge, 3× a sure thing more often than not. Default 2.25×: it costs the whole turn, but deed dice and Luck already swing a fight hard. Ordinary attacks already hit often, and the dice stop a roll near 95%, so above about 1.75× little changes for them; the rest helps long-shot rolls (a hard AC, a hard talk).

tiedStopsSpells.Name: Tied up stops spells
tiedStopsSpells.Hint: The rules don't say which spells need free hands, so this decides for all of them. On: a creature tied up can't cast. Off: it can, and may cast instead of struggling against its bonds.

Out.Saved: Saved from bleeding out: -1 Stamina for good, and a scar
